name: Triage support tickets
tagline: Customer emails come into your assistant inbox. I classify, set urgency, draft a reply, ping Slack — you approve before anything sends.
description: Inbound customer email lands in your workspace inbox; I read it (including any attached screenshots), classify it (billing/bug/how-to/feature/complaint), set urgency, draft a response in your tone, and drop a one-line summary plus draft in Slack. You approve before any reply goes out.

approvals.reason: Customer replies always need a human OK.

test_cases.name: how-to question with clear answer

input.subject: How do I export reports?
input.body: I can't figure out where to export the monthly report. Help?

test_cases.rubric: Classified as how_to + low. Drafts a 3–5 sentence reply pointing to the export feature. Slack one-liner + draft below.

test_cases.name: billing — refund request

input.subject: Refund please
input.body: I was charged twice this month. Refund me.

test_cases.rubric: Classified as billing + medium. Draft acknowledges the double charge and promises to investigate WITHOUT committing to a refund — that's owner's call. Slack summary present.

test_cases.name: production-down complaint

input.subject: URGENT: site is down
input.body: Our site has been down for 30 minutes. This is unacceptable.

test_cases.rubric: Classified as complaint + high. Slack summary uses an attention prefix. Draft reply acknowledges the frustration and outage, says someone is looking now, asks for any error message or screenshot.

test_cases.name: screenshot bug report
test_cases.rubric: Agent calls document_understand on the screenshot, classifies bug, drafts a reply asking for browser + OS + steps to reproduce.

test_cases.name: feature request

input.subject: Could you build SSO?
input.body: We'd love to use you company-wide but we need SAML SSO. Any plans?

test_cases.rubric: Classified as feature_request. Draft thanks them, asks 1–2 questions about their underlying need (compliance? Size? Identity provider?), makes no promises about ship date.
